svg.title: AIR and dynamic programming under a fixed ELR budget

cc:Work.dc:title: AIR and dynamic programming under a fixed ELR budget
cc:Work.dc:description: Conditional deterministic tangent-alignment model, not actual MuonH training. Both schedules have the same prescribed 8-update warmup, peak 0.2, zero final applied rate, and cumulative ELR. The common budget is chosen from AIR rounded once to a 64-level grid. The displayed continuous AIR calibrates alpha to match that exact budget; dynamic programming computes a schedule on the nested grid with 256 intervals (257 allowed rates). All axes are linear.
